patterns.note: Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often using a grid-based layout for presenting product categories, services, or articles, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles and a more neutral, readable sans-serif for body text and descriptive labels.
A brand-specific dark teal/green is used for the footer and key textual elements, contrasted with a clean white and light grey for backgrounds, and a vibrant green for call-to-action buttons.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, maintaining constant access to key links without visual transformation.
Horizontal carousels are used for displaying testimonials and team members, allowing users to swipe through content within a fixed section, indicated by navigation arrows.
Product and service offerings are presented in a card-based layout, featuring clear imagery, concise titles, and a call-to-action within a subtle border or shadow.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that stays fixed at the top of the screen during scroll, without visual transformation.

Content sections like 'Our medical team' and 'More than 100,000 men trust' utilize a horizontal carousel system (likely 'swiper' as hinted) to display multiple items in a scrollable format, indicated by navigation arrows.
Visual hierarchy is reinforced by using a large, bold sans-serif font for main headings and a lighter weight, smaller sans-serif for body text, ensuring readability and clear content segmentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller, uppercase labels for navigation and categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to cards, buttons, and input fields, softening the overall aesthetic without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used throughout, with generous vertical padding between sections and a consistent grid-based rhythm for content blocks, creating an airy yet structured feel.

standout: This site stands out by effectively blending a clean, modern medical aesthetic with a friendly, approachable tone, achieved through a consistent brand color palette and a clear, product-focused card layout. The use of a subtle red underline as a unique accent adds a distinctive touch to key headlines.
